title: Final Energy Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The internal energy U must be correctly stated as U = 3NkT.

title: Final Pressure Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The pressure P must be correctly stated as P = NkT/V.

title: Comparison with Ordinary Gas
description: Important Criteria: The internal energy comparison with an ordinary gas must be correctly articulated as U_monoatomic = (3/2)NkT.

title: Partition Function Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the single particle partition function Z_1 must be correctly derived.

title: Pressure Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of pressure from free energy must be correctly shown.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes in the equations, particularly in energy and pressure derivations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
